evidence.title: Delegatus readme
evidence.locator: Quick start; Docker; How it works; Tasks and the board; Pipelines and review loops
evidence.finding: Delegatus has macOS and Debian/Ubuntu launcher packages and a browser UI served by its CLI. It runs agent work on the operators own machine/accounts, with one orchestrator per project and tasks/pipelines in Git worktrees.

evidence.title: Delegatus docs/guide/accounts-and-roles.md
evidence.locator: Accounts; Compatible providers; Roles; Codex CLI versions
evidence.finding: The guide documents native Claude, Codex and Copilot account login, a Claude-compatible provider URL/token route, role-specific engine selection and supported Codex CLI versions. Copilot is a single-agent route rather than an orchestrator engine.

evidence.title: Delegatus src/lib/agent/cli.ts
evidence.locator: AgentEngine; resolveCodexBinary; resolveCopilotBinary; CLI boot/resume command specifications
evidence.finding: The launch implementation resolves installed Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot CLI executables and constructs boot/resume specifications. This is coding-harness integration, not inference from model aliases.

evidence.title: Delegatus docs/guide/orchestrator.md
evidence.locator: Create the orchestrator; What it does for you; Tick panel
evidence.finding: The product supplies a versioned standing mandate for a designated project orchestrator. It plans task pipelines, starts builder/reviewer stages, reacts to pipeline/decision events and can wake on selected periodic ticks. Merge automation is opt-in.

evidence.title: Delegatus docs/guide/interface.md
evidence.locator: Task cards; board columns; task creation and pipeline views
evidence.finding: The product interface shows persistent task cards with agent/pipeline status. The board is distinct from an agent conversation list.

evidence.title: Delegatus docs/guide/pipelines.md
evidence.locator: Stage worktree and review loop; merge setting
evidence.finding: A pipeline runs agent stages in its own Git worktree and keeps its pull request associated with the task. A failed review can return to the builder; merge authority is controlled separately from opening the PR.

evidence.title: Delegatus docs/guide/security-and-privacy.md
evidence.locator: Telemetry, lines21-38; local bind and access key
evidence.finding: A production Viewer sends a daily version/OS/architecture/install-kind ping with a separate random UUID to the vendor. It is enabled by default and can be switched off under Settings Privacy or by DELEGATUS_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1. Development/test/CI modes do not send it.

evidence.title: Delegatus src/lib/telemetry/store.ts
evidence.finding: Telemetry preferences default enabled=true. Environment opt-outs override that preference; preference updates persist individual fields.

evidence.title: Delegatus src/lib/telemetry/sender.ts
evidence.locator: sendInstallPing; scheduleInstallPing; URL and JSON body
evidence.finding: The sender checks the environment and saved preference before posting id, version, OS, arch and installation kind to https://delegatus.org/api/ping.

evidence.title: Delegatus src/components/telemetry/TelemetrySettings.tsx
evidence.finding: The component renders the first-start installation-ping notice and opens the Privacy settings window. It persists notice dismissal, not the enabled telemetry preference. The security-and-privacy guide separately documents the in-app telemetry switch.
